text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in modest green territory over the last day, with BTC outpacing ETH slightly, suggesting some rotation toward the largest asset during a period of overall caution. The Fear & Greed index at 27 reflects genuine market anxiety, though the 12-point rise over a week hints at gradual stabilization from worse lows. Bitcoin dominance holding above 56% paired with $80B in daily volume indicates measured engagement rather than panic liquidation or euphoric buying.
